title: Raw water turbidity · 2025
description: Monthly maximum, minimum and average turbidity for each Skaneateles raw-water intake.
match_method: Source file URL compared with official catalog. Related topics can exist in other datasets.
limitations: DataCuse extraction of Table 8 only; this is raw intake water, not a tap-water compliance assessment.
The reported cumulative averages are 0.49 NTU (intake 1) and 0.67 NTU (intake 2); these are not recomputed from the rounded monthly values.

provenance.method: Text-layer extraction; month rows and six measurement columns verified against rendered table.
